# Establishment log — bardo-thodol-006 (pp. 54–62), 2026-11-21

Read by three readers (strongest model; pp. 54–56, 57–59, 60–62), each checking the stored dzogchengonpa.org witness
line by line against crops of the page images (×3, ×5–×10 on doubt; pixel dumps where a tsheg was in question). Five print
lines on every page; the witness's line breaks match the print on all 45 lines read. Leaf-front ornament ༄༅༔ ༔ on pp. 55, 57,
59, 61 as expected. The part begins with སེམས་དཔའ་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་དང༔ on p. 54 l. 1 (after bardo-thodol-005's …འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔) and ends
at …དེ་ལྟར་ཡིན་པར་ངོ་ཤེས་པར་གྱིས་ཤིག༔ at the end of p. 62 l. 5, where a sentence closes; p. 63 was not needed.
Image overruled the witness: 21 (A) + 11 (B) + 17 (C) = 49. [?]: 4 (54.1 སྒྲིབ་པ, བ/པ; 57.2 དྲག་བོས, བ/པ; 58.3 ཡུན་རིང་, tsheg
before ༔ unseen or present; 62.5 ལྷུན་གྱིས, གྱིས/ཀྱི). Full tables in readings/read_A-log.md, read_B-log.md, read_C-log.md.

## Decisions taken when assembling (for the drafter)
- `# fix:` lines (15): tshegs missing at line joins: ཡིན|པས (54.4), གི|རྒྱུ (54.5→55.1, across the leaf-front ornament; the
  build strips the ornament before applying fixes, so the fix is written without it), སྡང|མེད (55.1), གཅིག|ལ (58.1), སོ་སོའི|སྣང
  (59.1), གྱི|ཞིང (60.4), འཆར|རོ (61.1), ལྷའི|ཐུབ (61.3), ནས|འོང (62.4); tshegs missing mid-line: མ་བྱེདཅིག (55.2), མི་སྲིདདོ (58.2),
  དག་སྣངདང (58.3). Each checked to apply exactly once.
- Treated as clear misprints (README rule 5b; each unit's note must name the print's reading):
  - 59.1 ༔སྐོ༔ → ངོ (the syllable after the leaf-front ornament, completing p. 58's …ཤར་ནས་འོང་ → འོང་ངོ༔). The letters as cut are
    ས over ཀ with naro (checked by reader B pixel by pixel against སྐད in the same line, and by the run on a ×4 crop); no sense
    here; the formula is འོང་ངོ༔ throughout, and the other recension has འཆར་ནས་འོང་ངོ༔. Fix written ནས་འོང་སྐོ༔ => ནས་འོང་ངོ༔.
  - 59.5 ཞེས་ཁྱ་བ → ཞེས་བྱ་བ "called" (the letter is plainly ཁ; the sense allows only བྱ; the other recension བྱ).
  - 61.2 གཞིན་རྗེ་གཤེད་པོ → གཤིན་རྗེ (Yamāntaka; the image shows ཞ; the other recension གཤིན་རྗེའི་གཤེད་པོ).
- Kept as printed, with a note:
  - 55.5 བཞོག་ཅིག for ཞོག་ཅིག "rest" (the print has ཞོག at 54.5; other recension ཞོག). Could be a variant spelling; not one way.
  - 60.5 the northern realm is རབ་རྫོགས་པ here and at 57.5, as in the other recension, where 53.4 (part 005) had རབ་བརྩེགས་པ.
  - 58.1 ལས་འཕྲོ་ཇི་ལྟར་ཞན་ཡང "however weak the karmic residue": ཡང for ཀྱང, as 47.2–3.
  - 58.5 དུས་ཅིག for དུས་གཅིག "at once" (58.5 has དུས་གཅིག just before).
  - The print's own spellings: རྣམ་བར, དྲག་བོས, གྲུབ་བས, རིམ་བ, ཡིན་བས; ཀྱེ beside ཀྱཻ (62.3); བོས (59.1) for འབོད.
  - ང standing directly before ༔ (no tsheg) and the page-to-page variation in a tsheg before ༔ (p. 61 has it after every དང,
    pp. 60 and 62 mostly not): transcribed as seen.
- Senses where the other recension differs:
  - 55.2 the print adds བློ་དམན་པ་ཡིན་ནའང་ "even if your mind is weak".
  - 56.5 ཞེན་པ་སྤོངས "give up clinging" (other: བག་ཆགས་སྤོངས), as at 51.3.
  - 59.1 no "listen undistracted" after the vocative (the print has ཉོན་ཅིག at 59.4 instead); 59.2 བག་ཆགས་ཀྱི་དབང (other:
    བག་ཆགས་ངན་པའི); 59.4 རང་སྣང་དུ་མ་ཤེས་པས (other: ངོ་མ་ཤེས་པས་ད་བར་དུ).
  - 61.4 the human sage is ཤཱཀྱ་སེངྒེ (other: ཤཱཀྱ་ཐུབ་པ); 62.2 སྣང་བ་ལས་འཆར་བ "arise from" (other: ལ); 62.4 the realms "are"
    the four quarters and centre of your heart (other: abide in them); 62.5 the print adds ལྷུན་གྱིས.
- Filler dots at line ends are left out of the text, as in 002–005.
